legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: All training content must promote safe work practices and model correct hazard management behaviour.
content_rules: Always promote safe work practices
Never present unsafe behaviour as correct
Include hazard identification where relevant
Include risk controls using practical workplace examples
Model correct PPE usage when applicable
Demonstrate correct incident reporting procedures
scenario_rules: Scenarios must reflect realistic workplace hazards
Unsafe actions must result in corrective feedback
Emergency and incident reporting procedures must be correct
Include supervisor consultation where safety decisions are made
assessment_rules: Correct answers must align with safe work practices
Incorrect answers should explain safety consequences
Assessment tasks must not encourage unsafe actions

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Learner information and workplace data must be handled responsibly and respectfully in accordance with Australian Privacy Principles.
content_rules: Avoid unnecessary personal data collection
Use fictional or anonymised personal information in examples
Model respectful handling of digital and paper records
Demonstrate secure storage and disposal of records
scenario_rules: Scenarios involving records must demonstrate confidentiality
Digital systems must be shown as password-protected where relevant
Personal information must only be shared on a need-to-know basis
assessment_rules: Do not require learners to disclose real personal information
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Using real personal data in examples
Showing unlocked screens with sensitive data

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Training content must be inclusive, fair, and free from discrimination. Represent diversity in workplace roles.
content_rules: Use inclusive and respectful language
Avoid stereotypes or biased assumptions
Include diverse workplace roles and contexts
Use gender-neutral job titles where possible
Represent people of different ages, abilities, and backgrounds
scenario_rules: Scenarios must not normalise bullying or harassment
Discriminatory behaviour must be corrected, not rewarded
assessment_rules: Correct answers must support fair treatment

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Learners should understand basic workplace expectations, professional behaviour, and employment rights.
content_rules: Promote respectful communication
Model professional workplace conduct
Encourage appropriate supervision and feedback
Show workers understanding their rights
scenario_rules: Supervisory roles must act responsibly and fairly
Workers should be shown raising concerns appropriately
assessment_rules: Correct answers must align with reasonable workplace behaviour

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: All content must meet Australian VET training and assessment standards for RTOs. Content must be valid, reliable, flexible, and fair.
content_rules: Content must align to unit requirements and performance criteria
Learning materials must be clear and learner-friendly
Reasonable adjustment must be supported
Content must be current and industry-relevant
scenario_rules: Simulated workplaces must be realistic and achievable
Tasks must be solvable using provided information
Contexts should reflect actual industry practice
assessment_rules: Assessment must be fair, valid, reliable, and flexible
Do not trick learners with irrelevant complexity
Provide clear instructions and marking criteria
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Content not mapped to performance criteria

prompt_injection_block.system_instruction: All generated content must comply with Australian WHS, privacy (APPs), equal opportunity, and VET training requirements. Safety, inclusivity, and learner fairness must be prioritised at all times. Use Australian English spelling (behaviour, organisation, colour, centre).
